reviews.title: “Guides”
reviews.text: Took 2 supposedly guided tours booked through GetYourGuide. The so-called guides were not familiar with the cities they were supposedly giving the tours in (Tokyo and Kyoto). They drove past significant sites (for example the Imperial Palace and Gardens in Tokyo) and could not recommend places to eat lunch in the areas we visited. Seems that is what guides are supposed to do? We ended up looking up information on the internet including sights to see and their historical significance. I will definitely think twice before ever booking a tour with this company.

reviews.title: Not everyone in this app is 100% reputable and honest
reviews.text: I had an experience with Bourbon Bites for a tour in Kentucky and they cancelled on us less than 2 hours before. Told me I’d get a refund due to this incident of cancelling and they would rebook for another day if I chose to. They did rebook but not for what I originally booked for. So not the same day, time or all the same places. I was told we would get 3 tours and 3 tastings. Not all of this happened either. Then he proceeded to tell me he reimbursed  me.  It’s been a week and a 1/2 and still no money. He keeps telling me it will just take longer to see it. He did just enough for us to say well at least we got a little of something but not what we booked!!! And why lie and say you will reimburse me? I will no longer trust this site for reputable companies. And will never use or endorse Bourbon Bites tours again!

reviews.title: Terrible customer service

I requested that they at least follow up with the tour agency and have them re-write their listing to be more clear, and they refused to do that as well. I’ve deleted this app and will never use GYG again.

reviews.title: Great Platform, Disappointing Customer Service and Billing Resolution
reviews.text:
I’ve used GetYourGuide several times and have never had any issues, which is why I’m hesitant to leave a one-star review. However, the lack of responsiveness and urgency in resolving my recent issue has compelled me to share my experience.

I was charged for both a canceled reservation and an active reservation, and the payment has already posted to my bank statement. It has now been over 10 business days since I should have received a refund for the canceled excursion. On top of that, I never received the tickets for the excursion I actually paid for.

I made multiple attempts to resolve this before my trip through emails, messages, and phone calls, but the issue was never resolved. Each time, I was told that the case was being escalated and that the finance team needed to investigate because the charge was not showing up on their end. After repeated attempts without a resolution, I ultimately had to file a dispute with my credit card company, which is still under investigation.

I genuinely like GetYourGuide and intend to continue using the platform, but the lack of timely communication, accountability, and urgency in handling this situation caused unnecessary stress during my trip. I understand that billing issues can happen, but I expected much better customer support and a timely resolution. I hope GetYourGuide takes these concerns seriously and improves how situations like this are handled.

They should be promoting marine conservation yet they work with organisations such as Teada in Naha and other Japanese dive and snorkelling companies who have no regard for protecting the coral. Dropping anchor on the coral and no offering ANY educational facts to their participants who clearly have no clue that touching and standing on coral can kill it.

reviews.title: Slechte ervaring en onverwachte meerprijs
reviews.text:
We boekten een ballonvaart voor €143. Helaas werd onze ballonvaart twee keer geannuleerd. Uiteindelijk moesten we €210 betalen, zonder enige compensatie voor het ongemak.

Als reden voor de annulering werd overmacht aangehaald vanwege een airshow. Voor zover wij weten, was deze airshow vooraf gepland. Daarom vinden we het moeilijk te begrijpen waarom dit als overmacht werd beschouwd en waarom de gevolgen hiervan voor onze rekening kwamen.

We zijn erg teleurgesteld over de manier waarop dit werd afgehandeld. Een duidelijke uitleg, een eerlijke oplossing en meer begrip voor de klant hadden we op zijn minst verwacht.

Op basis van onze ervaring kunnen we deze aanbieder helaas niet aanbevelen.

I booked for a river cruise I couldn’t find where we had to go I put it on google maps and I went round in circles for over 30 minutes still couldn’t find it I paid £57 for a half hour river cruise that no one can find I spoke to 2 other families who had booked with the same river cruise and they couldn’t find i. reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.text:
We booked the sightseeing tour through this app, but unfortunately, the bus didn’t arrive on time. At the last minute, we were told that the bus had broken down and that there would be a delay of around 2 hours and 30 minutes. The bus eventually arrived at nearly 12 pm instead of the scheduled 9 am.

Because of the delay, we had to rush to see the sights, and by the time we arrived, most of the shops and attractions were already closed. We didn’t get to experience everything that was included in the tour, and our evening plans were also badly affected.

Unfortunately, we didn’t receive a full refund despite the significant disruption. Overall, it was a very disappointing experience, and I would not recommend this company.

reviews.title: Important information is hard to find .
reviews.text:
HIGHLIGHT IMPORTANT ADDITIONAL INFORMATION !!! 

GYG obviously has a lot of activities available but you have to deep dive into the descriptions to find important information . For example on our boat tour we had not received any information about what boat we were getting on and there was many boats all leaving at the same time, on very similar tours and from the same provider . On two other activities , it wasn’t until searching the bottom of the description that we found we needed to bring passports etc . If we didn’t check we would of wasted our money . Also a lot of rentals require physical debit/credit cards none of this information was provided . I am not 100% sure whether this is GYG fault or the providers of the activities not providing accurate information. Fortunately we went on all our activities but only because we double checked . Contact numbers and actual physical points of contact at event locations would be a huge addition to the app .

The rest of the app is fine for booking, but let me finish writing before you publish my words.

reviews.title: AI ‘Agents’ and stolen money.
reviews.text:
Spent £70 on a day trip, with the money immediately removed from my account, and the email supposed to be containing the voucher instead telling me “Your refund will be processed within 5 business days”. So, a resolvable server-side error, right?

The AI support chat bot sent me to a ‘Agent’, who was… also a chat bot that repeatedly ignored my request to get a customer complaints email. After 30 minutes of being given the absolute wrong information, and multiple ignored requests while ‘Lance’ just constantly repeating the same message of “we cannot expedite the process”, we were then given a fake email.

This site is a 3rd Party site that connects you to your trip provider, and yet cannot do its sole purpose, and ensures that you have absolutely zero way to genuinely work through for its mistakes because there is nobody to go to when it goes wrong.

reviews.title: Awful customer support
reviews.text:
I booked an activity through get your guide for me and my partner when we went on holiday recently. My activity provider was supposed to message / email me the day before my activity if there was an update to the pick up location or time. After looking over my inboxes to see nothing I inquired, however, I only received a reply late into the night (01:15), by which time I was already asleep. I then woke up too late as my pick up time was moved earlier. I instantly tried to get in contact with my provider to no avail. 

I then contacted get your guide customer support. I let them know my situation and they informed me I had received an email of the updated pick up time the day before my activity, of which I had opened and viewed. This is a blatant lie as I had not seen any email let alone open it. I tried to explain this but customer support said the situation was dealt with and left the chat. I continued to message but they wouldn’t reply.

This is absolutely unacceptable. I’m a 19 yr old student that decided to spend a lot of my money (£120) on a special experience for me and my partner. I also booked a cheap activity for later in my trip with get your guide, it went smoothly after receiving a text about pick up time the day before, showing that I am not in the wrong. I demand a full refund.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Wij hebben een activiteit geboekt op Curaçao en er kwam niemand opdagen. Navraag bij de tourist information leverde ons de kennis op dat dit al ruim een jaar een bekend malafide onderneming is. Het gaat om Water taxi in Willemstad. Getyourguide kon niets voor ons doen dus dat telefoon gesprek van Curaçao naar Duitsland heeft ook alleen maar geld gekost. De klantenservice snapt kennelijk niet dat het gesprek nogal wat geld kost en laat je eindeloos wachten zonder dat het resultaat oplevert.

reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: We had 2 tours booked through this platform as it seemed convenient to have this all in one place. However, the first tour, a private boat tour of Capri was cancelled <24 hours in advance quoting poor weather/water conditions. We booked a separate tour (shared as it was too last minute for a private booking) and the weather conditions were not only perfect, they were never predicted to be bad nor had any other company cancelled their tours. We suspect we were cancelled due to being a 2 person private party on a tour that provides food and drink when a larger party would be more desirable but I can’t prove that. Now, I receive a WhatsApp message at 11 pm the night before a 9 am tour of tangier leaving from Morocco, and they want an additional $50 because the pick up location of our hotel is outside the city center. The address for pickup was provided at the time of booking over a month ago. The company claims they were unable to reach me via WhatsApp, but they only tried recently and did not try via the get your guide messages until I reached out to them to get information. This seems like a last minute scam to get more mi et when they know we are committed to this tour in just a little over 9 hours. I will not be booking through get your guide again.

reviews.title: When it works it’s great when it doesn’t your whole trip is messed up
reviews.text: We did a Vatican tour that was really great. We also booked an underground tour of the colosseum and planned our trip around this booking as it’s what we were all looking forward to. They canceled 1 week before due to a political event that day. First how did they not know this earlier. Second after some research it wasn’t true that this wasn’t available. I was able to rebook the colosseum but not the underground with another company. So in the end someone messed and then seems to me they made an excuse about it. Get your guide relayed the message to me. When I called get your guide they said it wasn’t available and there was nothing they could do, except send me a list of things I could rebook around the colosseum. But they would not give a discount for anything else as they are just a broker. In the end we didn’t get to do the underground tour which we planned the trip around and no one is being held accountable and no one tried to make it right with us.

reviews.title: Confusing Payment and Refund System
reviews.text:
I am very disappointed with my experience with GetYourGuide.
I had several cancelled tours that were eligible for a full refund, but trying to understand what happened to my money has been incredibly frustrating. Different members of the support team gave me different explanations about the same bookings. One person told me a refund had been sent, while another told me the booking had never been charged in the first place.
As a customer, this is very confusing. I had to spend hours checking bank statements, contacting my bank, collecting transaction references, and following up multiple times just to understand where my money went.
What upset me most is that I received conflicting information instead of clear answers. When it comes to customers' money, there should be transparency and consistency.
I used GetYourGuide because I expected a reliable and stress-free booking experience. Unfortunately, dealing with these refunds has been one of the most frustrating customer service experiences I have had.
I hope the company improves its payment and refund processes so that other customers do not have to go through the same situation.

reviews.title: Unnecessary privacy invasive steps
reviews.text:
The actual process of purchasing tickets through GetYourGuide was fantastic—it worked incredibly fast, and the transaction itself was very easy. If the experience ended there, it would easily be a 5-star review.
However, retrieving the actual tickets was incredibly frustrating. I was forced to download the app and enter a bunch of details just to access what I had already paid for. To make matters worse, the app pushes you to allow access to your data. While you can technically opt out of sharing your data with their affiliates, they don't make it easy; you have to go through the affiliated businesses one by one to turn it off.
I was very disappointed by all these unnecessary, privacy-invasive steps just to get a ticket. Great for booking, but expect some tedious hoops to jump through afterward.

reviews.title: Expensive mistake, will not use again
reviews.text:
TLDR: Bad service, insufficient information provided prior to booking, location based services inaccurate, suggestion-based algorithm flawed. This was an expensive mistake and we will not use this service again. 

The booking (Sirmione at sunset) was set to meet in an area that we had no way to get to or back from (literally NO taxi available within 4+ hours to get there OR back (called 4 companies and had our hotel call taxis services as well) without any availability, no ferry OR buses available on the way back because the cruise ends too late (last ferry at 1835 and last bus at 1935). I booked this thinking that it was sirmione because I was searching specifically for sirmione and all of the other tours under my search were leaving from the same dock in sirmione near scaglieri. Somehow this one made it past the “departure location: sirmione” search.  Once I booked it and could not cancel (though attempted to), I figured there would be SOME form of transportation to/from the area, but there was not and now we are out quite a bit of money and the whole experience has been frustrating and stressful. The GetyourGuide staff stated they could not do anything about it, nor even refund the extra paid for wine that we will not drink, and ended our chat without allowing me to respond and before I was able to ask additional questions. Then, when I attempted to reopen the dialogue with another agent, they stated I had been assisted already and closed the chat. This occurred twice.

reviews.title: 你即便付款成功也不一定有票
reviews.text:
我雖然事前訂票了也付款成功（梵蒂岡）
還好我活動前兩天有主動上去確認
我看到我的票仍在處理中
但跟我同時訂票的旅伴已經有票了
我主動聯繫客服後
他們才跟我說我的票有問題
然後就直接取消我當初的訂票 並說要退款給我

讓我很生氣的點是
他們完全不會主動事前通知你
你必須自己上去做確認並主動聯繫
若是你沒這麼做
那可能會到活動當天你才發現你沒有票（甚至是顯示「正在處理中」）
若你訂的票是很熱門的景點的票
而到那時 基本很難有立即補救的方法了
那天的行程就會直接毀掉

很爛 非常爛 很生氣的購票體驗
用戶要自己多加注意一下

Even though I booked the Vatican tickets in advance and the payment went through successfully, luckily I decided to check the booking status myself two days before the activity.

I noticed that my tickets were still marked as “processing.”
After I contacted customer service myself, they then told me there was a problem with my tickets. They directly cancelled my original booking and said they would refund me.

What really made me angry is that they do not proactively notify you in advance at all.
You have to check the status yourself and contact customer service on your own.

If you do not do that, you might only realize on the actual day of the activity that you do not have valid tickets — sometimes the status may still even show “processing.”

If the tickets are for a very popular attraction, by that point there is basically no immediate way to fix the situation. Your entire plan for the day could be ruined.

Very bad. Extremely frustrating ticket purchasing experience.

reviews.title: Would leave 0 if possible.
reviews.text:
I am writing to formally express my disappointment regarding the extremely poor experience we had with our recent booking.

We booked this boat trip several months in advance and arrived at the designated meeting point on time, only to be left stressed and confused as we were unable to locate the operator or receive any communication beforehand. It was only three minutes before the scheduled start time that we received a message via online chat stating that the trip had been cancelled due to “weather conditions.”

This explanation was highly questionable given that the weather was clear, hot, and calm, with no obvious conditions that would have prevented the trip from operating safely. The complete lack of notice and communication was unacceptable, especially considering the amount of time we had planned around this booking.

As a result of the last-minute cancellation, we were forced to arrange an alternative boat trip at a significantly higher cost in order to avoid our day being completely ruined. To make matters worse, we were then informed that the cancellation had been marked as if it were initiated by us, which is entirely inaccurate.

This experience fell far below any reasonable standard of customer service and caused unnecessary stress, inconvenience, and additional expense. I would strongly urge you to review how situations like this are handled, as I would not want other customers to go through the same experience.

reviews.title: terrible customer service
reviews.text:
I booked the tour for the Vatican on this app. I had to reschedule due to timing and they issued me a gift card for their website which I then used to purchase two more tours for my trip to Rome. One tour I completely missed even though I showed up early and called their customer service. They promised to call me back and help me. Nobody called me back. Nobody helped me. I was left stranded in a foreign country with no tour walking around asking strangers to take me on a tour. The other tour got canceled about an hour before the tour started. So we were literally in route to the Sistine Chapel and told unfortunately, they overbooked tickets and therefore you can’t go.. 

I called them. They said they would issue a refund but only as a gift card. Who in their right mind would ever use this service again after having this terrible experience? I called their customer service. I chatted. I asked for a manager seven times and was told that the Manager is at lunch. I then got an email saying that their decision is final and basically they’re holding onto all of my money as a gift card and refused to refund it to me. I would book with anybody but GetYourGuide.

reviews.title: Review Title: Avoid At All Costs—Zero Support When You Actually Need It
reviews.text: I have been a loyal user of GetYourGuide for a long time, booking most of my travel experiences through the app, but a recent experience has made it clear that they are an unreliable, money-hungry middleman that offers zero protection to their customers. Despite paying the inflated prices often found on this platform compared to booking directly, I realized that the "convenience" is a total facade because they refuse to work with you when situations arise that are completely out of your control. When I faced an issue that was entirely out of my hands, I wasn't even demanding a full refund—I would have been satisfied with a simple credit—yet they flat-out refused to help, proving that they only care about taking your money and nothing about customer retention or fairness. Do not be fooled by the slick interface; you are paying a premium for a service that disappears the second something goes wrong, and I strongly urge others to book directly with tour operators instead of wasting money on a platform that hides behind rigid policies to pocket your cash.

reviews.title: Horrible

reviews.title: Cairo to Luxor Day Tour/ Airline Tickets included
reviews.text: Get Your Guide Booked and charged Tour in October 2025 provided electronic tickets, but never purchased the actual airline tickets for the expensive Booked tour scheduled for March 25,2026.  Get Your Guide just recommended to cancel the day before the Booked tour after informing their activity provider “Nice Tours” was unable to successfully purchase airline tickets even after requesting an additional charge to purchase Business Class airline beyond the original booking price of the tour package, even advising Business Class tickets as an option and never purchased any airline tickets for the tour package. This was close to $4k in U.S. dollars spent related to this tour package between October 2025 and March 2026 with Get Your Guide and their direct activity provider “Nice Tours” just to plan travel from the U.S. to Cairo, Egypt for the activity provider  “Nice Tours” to recommend canceling the trip only one day prior to the actual tour since the activity provider “Nice Tour” were unable to purchase 7 airline tickets between October 2025 and March 2026. Thousands of U.S. dollars were spent for this experience and to only get notified by Get Your Guide activity provider “Nice Tours” one day before the tour is a bad and very expensive especially experience when Get Your Guide provided electronic tickets for the tour package but never booked the actual airline tickets for the tour. Recommend Get Your Guide to have better/ trustworthy activity providers that can be trusted or not

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs
reviews.text:
I had an extremely disappointing experience with this company and I feel compelled to warn other travellers.

I was in Marrakesh for only three days with my daughter, and one of those days had been carefully planned around a trip to Essaouira, which was something she had wanted to do for a very long time and was meant to be a highlight of her birthday trip.

At 10:30 the night before the excursion, I received an email informing me that the trip had been cancelled because they did not have enough people booked.

Cancelling at that time is completely unacceptable. When customers book and pay for an excursion, they do so in good faith and expect the company to honour the booking. The company’s inability to fill seats should not suddenly become the customer’s problem at the last minute, especially when there is no realistic opportunity to arrange an alternative tour.

Because of this late cancellation, the entire plan for that day was ruined and we had no time to find another organised trip to Essaouira. On a short three-day visit, that effectively meant we lost the chance to do the one activity my daughter had been most excited about.

This reflects very poor customer service and extremely poor planning. If a trip depends on a minimum number of participants, that should either be made very clear at the time of booking or the company should notify customers much earlier if the trip will not run.

Cancelling at 10:30 pm the night before is simply not acceptable.

reviews.title: Major App Glitch & Dishonest Support.
reviews.text:
I want to start by clarifying that the local guide was excellent. This review is strictly for GetYourGuide’s platform and predatory customer service.
I booked a tour that completely failed to appear in my GetYourGuide app. Fearing I had no booking, I was forced to re-book the same experience through Viator (who, ironically, was much more helpful). After the cancellation window passed, the tour suddenly "appeared" in my GYG app.
When I contacted support with time-stamped screenshots proving the app was empty when I needed it, the representative was dismissive and claimed the booking "had been there the whole time." It is incredibly disappointing to be gaslit by a company when their own technical glitch caused the issue.
The Contrast: Viator was willing to work with me on a cancellation even past the window, while GetYourGuide refused to take accountability for their own app’s failure. I will be sticking with Viator or booking directly with local operators from now on.

reviews.title: Don’t believe GYG description
reviews.text: We booked a tour in Hong Kong that, according to the title and the description, included a dim sum lunch. The first thing our tour guide told us was this tour does not include lunch, as if she anticipated we all believed it did. All members of the group were a bit angry to be misled. Our tour guide was great, but we did not appreciate GYG misleading us into thinking the tour included lunch. The tour description clearly showed that lunch was included. The checklist of what was included also clearly showed lunch was included “if option selected.”  There were no other options to select, not only for the date we selected but also for any future dates we checked after realizing we were ripped off. When I went to leave a review, the rate your review part of our tour was crossed off as completed. Imagine that. I contacted customer service and was given different excuses. The rating option was sent to your email and perhaps went to junk mail. It was not GYG’s description, it was the local tour provider we use. We’re sorry and we will escalate your situation. And then, they ghosted me on the customer support chat. It was obvious that misleading the customer was intentional. We previously used GYG in Japan and were very, very happy with our tour there. But after this experience, Viator gets our future business.

reviews.title: Lame Customer Service
reviews.text: The app on my phone won’t let me login using Facebook. So when I book things on it, it is not connected to my account. I asked them to help me fix that as I was having difficulty contacting where I booked. And then on top of all of it, they lied to me and told me that other people would be I booked and I was the only one. And I told him that I would not book it unless I knew other people are going on it. I spent of my limited time going back-and-forth with customer service. I have used this app successfully in Scotland and other cities. Right now, I am in Athens. But nothing gets me more than people hiding behind customer service. I asked them to help me contact. Provider to move my booked slot forward an hour because of all the hassle and they just hid behind policy. Which is super funny because when I got to the place profusely and said of course that I could have taken the other slot. So they didn’t even try to help me. Airbnb experiences has much better customer service and you can actually contact the guide before out if other people are going on it and what they recommend. Even though this app has good content, they don’t deserve the business because they have such a terrible customer service ☹️

reviews.title: Do not book through get your guide. Unreasonable terms & conditions for cruise passengers
reviews.text: Please be warned that the 24 hrs before cancellation policy is not good for cruise passengers.  When you have no control over extreme weather conditions and the ship docking,     There is no refund when you can not get to the meeting  point on time.  I understand they have a schedule to keep to but no alternative was offered for a later departure time.  We have just lost £233 approx $460. Because of how difficult it was for the ship to dock due to extreme weather and sea conditions.  Cruise passengers can not  know 24 hrs before that this would be a problem.  The tour company have not been accommodating in trying to book us onto an alternative they just said it’s our policy.   Very disappointing.  I should of stayed with my original tour operator Viator they are more accommodating

reviews.title: Avoid!
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with GetYourGuide’s customer service. After my booking was confirmed as refundable by the provider, I was repeatedly told by a GetYourGuide staff member that my refund had already been issued. However, I never received any refund.

For over 1.5 months, I have been constantly chasing their support team, only to be told vague excuses like my case is “with the review team.” They have confirmed they received my emails, yet no one has taken real responsibility, and no one seems willing to properly investigate or even allow me to raise a formal complaint.

This experience has been frustrating, stressful, and completely unacceptable. Being misled about a refund and ignored for weeks shows a complete lack of professionalism and accountability. I strongly advise others to be very cautious before booking through GetYourGuide.

reviews.title: City of Lights St Augustine Florida
reviews.text: Abysmal. If I could give negative stars, I would. Because of our experience with a third party vendor, we will never book with a third party vendor ever again no matter what kind of discount provided. Pre booked and prepaid a City of Lights tour for December 7, 9 PM. Only in St Augustine for two days and the city experienced torrential rains. When we tried to reschedule directly with City of Lights, we were told that some of the carts were not even running due to electrical issues and light failures and that we needed to contact who we contracted with originally to see if we could reschedule. That led to hours on a chat application where you could not speak to a person in live time who said we scheduled a trip in Instanbul to which I responded no, and attached a screenshot of the reservation.  We were then told that we could not reschedule because the activity cost more and they could not change it once the activity was confirmed even if we wanted to pay the difference in cost. When I reiterated what we were told by a City of Lights representative, the agent reached out via phone to confirm, did not receive an answer, and sent a follow up email to confirm. We received an email update that essentially said we lied about the carts having electricity and that the activity wasn’t cancelled. Easy money made by crooks.
